metadata.question: Through the months of December 2018 and January 2019, did northern part of Madagascar (between latitude of -12 to -15) recieve less rain than the long-term average for the same two-month period from 2000 to 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use CHIRPS precipitation data (good global coverage, daily) - Compare Dec 2018 + Jan 2019 vs. the long-term average of Dec+Jan from 2000-2019 - Region: Madagascar, latitude -15 to -12 (northern part) 2. Masking strategy: - CHIRPS doesn't need cloud masking (it's a modeled precipitation product) - Just sum the precipitation values 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: If a region receives 0mm rain, that's a valid measurement (drought) - C1: No images in collection (unlikely for CHIRPS) - C2: No valid pixels after processing (unlikely unless geometry issue) - C3: Result is None/NaN - A: If 2018-2019 rain < long-term average - B: If 2018-2019 rain >= long-term average ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define region - northern Madagascar (lat -15 to -12) const region = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([43.0, -15.0, 51.0, -12.0]); // 2. Get CHIRPS precipitation data const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY'); // 3. Target period: Dec 2018 + Jan 2019 const target = chirps .filter(ee.Filter.date('2018-12-01', '2019-02-01')) .select('precipitation'); const targetSize = target.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Target period images: ${targetSize}`); if (targetSize === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Calculate total precipitation for target period const targetSum = target.sum(); const targetResult = targetSum.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const targetRain = targetResult.get('precipitation').getInfo(); if (targetRain === null || targetRain === undefined) { console.log('C3'); return; } // 5. Calculate long-term average for Dec+Jan (2000-2019) let totalLongterm = 0; let yearCount = 0; for (let year = 2000; year <= 2019; year++) { const decStart = `${year}-12-01`; const janEnd = `${year + 1}-02-01`; const yearCol = chirps .filter(ee.Filter.date(decStart, janEnd)) .select('precipitation'); const yearSize = yearCol.size().getInfo(); if (yearSize > 0) { const yearSum = yearCol.sum(); const yearResult = yearSum.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const yearRain = yearResult.get('precipitation').getInfo(); if (yearRain !== null && yearRain !== undefined) { totalLongterm += yearRain; yearCount++; } } } if (yearCount === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } const longtermAvg = totalLongterm / yearCount; // 6. Print evidence and answer console.log(`Dec2018-Jan2019 rainfall: ${targetRain.toFixed(2)} mm`); console.log(`Long-term avg (2000-2019): ${longtermAvg.toFixed(2)} mm`); console.log(`Years analyzed: ${yearCount}`); console.log(`Difference: ${(targetRain - longtermAvg).toFixed(2)} mm`); if (targetRain < longtermAvg) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
